_meta.purpose: HOME-BASED BUSINESS validity set (n=50). The actual lead-magnet population: thin public evidence, sole operators, statutory scale caps. Tests the 0.9.0 display_floor change on the population where evidence coverage is genuinely lowest.

tier_0_default.why: Free. Most skincare occasions resolve here.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Same treatment cheaper, no home setting.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same treatment, same occasion. Home studios compete with chains on price and with housecalls on convenience.

members: chains with brand recall and packages
home studios with strong review counts
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: Each holds a rung: 'the brand', 'the trusted home one', 'the qualified one'.

tier_4_adjacent_crossover.why: Same goal, different authority and price tier.

members: pushy package-selling damaging the category's reputation
tier_6_indirect.why: Reduces willingness to book at all.

derived_competitive_set._rules: HDB/URA Home-Based Business Scheme: small-scale only, operated by residents only, no non-resident employees, no signage or advertising at the premises, no large-scale storage.
